setups.quoteHint: The brass key to it had hung round her father's neck on a faded green ribbon
It was eleven minutes fast. It had been eleven minutes fast her whole childhood
Her father had kept it loaded for emergencies on the water
Three notes, always the same. Down, down, up.
She had not stood on a boat's open deck since she was nine
